versions.changelog:
Initial release of skill-audit — an automated Claude skill audit tool for GitHub repositories.

- Audits Claude skills for effectiveness, token usage, safety, permissions, and best-practice compliance.
- Generates structured reports with category ratings, evidence, recommendations, and positive findings.
- Automatically creates bilingual (English & Chinese) social media posts summarizing audit results.
- Logs all audit steps and status for traceability.
- Designed for easy integration into skill development workflows.
